newsitem.title: USA: MCI says in merger talks with BT.
newsitem.headline: MCI says in merger talks with BT.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said on Friday that it was in talks about a "business combination" with British Telecommunications Plc, which already has a 20 percent stake in the U.S. firm.
"We have entered into negotations with BT on a possible business combination," an MCI spokesman said, reading from a prepared statement.
"There can be no assurances that an agreement will be entered into, or that any transaction will be consummated," the spokesman said.
"MCI expects the negotations will be concluded this weekend and any announcement will be made at that time," he said.
MCI stock was halted at 29, up 3-7/8 at 1328 EST/1928 GMT. Analysts have speculated that an offer could be around $40 per share. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
